description: A script for cleaning up download directories in OpenWrt, removing older versions of program tarballs while keeping the latest.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a file or directory entry with methods to parse version info, delete files/directories, and compare versions.

methods.name: parseVer_123
methods.description: Parses version string matching pattern 1.2.3 with optional patch level.

methods.name: parseVer_12
methods.description: Parses version string matching pattern 1.2 with optional patch.

methods.name: parseVer_r
methods.description: Parses version string with a single number.

methods.name: parseVer_ymd_GIT_SHASUM
methods.description: Parses version string with date and GIT SHASUM.

methods.name: parseVer_GIT
methods.description: Uses file modification time as version.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to handle command-line arguments, process directory entries, and delete old versions.
